name: Memory Seal
description: Two primitives, both real, both client-side: a 12-rule contamination scanner (injected directives, secrets, contradictions, staleness) and Ed25519-sealed tamper-evident checkpoints that catch any add/remove/edit/reorder since sealing.
tagline: The integrity primitive for agent memory
caption: Memory Seal — The integrity primitive for agent memory. Paste MEMORY.md or daily notes and get evidence-bound findings — or seal a checkpoint before context compaction and prove nothing changed since.
honest_limits: Heuristic triage, not proof. A clean scan is not proof of clean memory. A checkpoint proves integrity since sealing, not truth.
